edits.name: grip-base

Each fist has curled fingers and a thumb visibly wrapped around an imaginary vertical slim handle, with the fist centred exactly on the current wrist/hand centre and still hanging low beside the hips. Keep the existing wrist junction, cuffs, sleeves, arms, elbows, shoulders, torso, head, legs, lighting, proportions, alpha silhouette and every pixel outside the two hand regions exactly unchanged. This is a precise masked inpaint, not a redraw of the figure.
